question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"uncertainty".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• **Certainty :**feeling of being completely sure about something.(किसी चीज के बारे में पूरी तरह से सुनिश्चित होने की भावना।)
 
• **Uncertainty :** means the lack of certainty or sureness of an event.(अनिश्‍चितता)
 
• **Reliability :**the quality or state of being reliable.(विश्‍वसनीयता)
 
• **Positivity:** the practice of being or tendency to be positive or optimistic in attitude.(सकारात्मकता)
 
 
 
• *"There is so much (1) ______ and confusion in life today because the goal of human beings is not clear." *Here in this given sentence, it is mentioned about having so much **confusion **in life because of which the goal of human beings is not clear.
 
• From the list of given meanings of the words,the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is **'uncertainty' **which means lack of certainty.
 
• Therefore,the correct answer is **option 2.**
 
• **Correct paragraph:** *There is so much **uncertainty** and confusion in life today because the goal of human beings is not clear. Each person (2) ______ to fulfil his desires and dreams without (3) ______ the interest of the other. When we have a (4) ______ motive, we lose the sense of the higher objective of attaining happiness. Therefore, there is lot of (5) ______ in our life.*

42:Tbf4,

The correct answer is **"wants".**
